facts.content: It has no effect on the interest rate. Therefore, it has absolutely no effect on the exchange rate. It doesn't move the exchange rate. It has no implication for the exchange rate. So this is smaller than it was in the closed economy, but it has no impact on the exchange rate. So unless the fiscal policy somehow affects interest rate, then there is no effect. And that's the reason why, in practice, when countries have sort of expansionary fiscal packages, the currency tends to appreciate it. It's because investors expect the Fed to react to that, or the central bank to react to that and raise interest rates.
